dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what's in this big box?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌts ɪn ðɪs ˈbɪɡ ˈbɑːks?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A new fan! It was so cheap that I bought two.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈnuː ˈfæn! ɪt wʌz ˈsoʊ ˈtʃiːp ðət aɪ ˈbɔːt ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Great! It's so hot at night that I can't sleep.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ɪts ˈsoʊ ˈhɑːt ət ˈnaɪt ðət aɪ ˈkænt ˈsliːp.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: But the delivery was so slow that I made a complaint.
dialogue.reading: bʌt ðə dɪˈlɪvəri wʌz ˈsoʊ ˈsloʊ ðət aɪ ˈmeɪd ə kəmˈpleɪnt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh no. Did the store apologize?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ. dɪd ðə ˈstɔːr əˈpɑːlədʒaɪz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, they apologized. But now one fan is missing!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ðeɪ əˈpɑːlədʒaɪzd. bʌt ˈnaʊ ˈwʌn ˈfæn ɪz ˈmɪsɪŋ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. They'll bring the other fan tomorrow.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðeɪl ˈbrɪŋ ði ˈʌðər ˈfæn təˈmɑːroʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Don't worry. There's a two-year guarantee!
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri. ðɛrz ə ˌtuː ˌjɪr ˌɡærənˈtiː!
